messages:
alex_h: Hey infra team — hitting a hard stop on EBS and snapshot throughput in us-west-2 for prod-account (123456789012). Nightly backups are timing out and our deploy tomorrow depends on increasing quotas. Need: +100TB total gp3, gp3 IOPS to ~500k, snapshots/min increase, and volumes-per-region up to 60k. Also need p4d GPU quota bump to 8 in us-west-2. Anyone have a support case text we can reuse?
sophia: Can you paste the errors or CloudWatch logs? infra-bot might show current quotas.
infra-bot: Account 123456789012 — current quotas (us-west-2): gp3 total provisioned size = 30720 GiB; gp3 IOPS quota = 10000; gp3 throughput quota = 5000 MiB/s; snapshots per minute ~ 40; volumes per region = 900; ENI limit = 5000. Observed snapshot spikes around 02:00 UTC correlating with full-volume backups.
raj_p: We saw the same spike last week. Incremental snapshots + grouping helped but not enough for the scale of the new dataset. Quota increase required.
michael_t: AWS will ask for expected sustained IOPS, architecture, and mitigation plans. I can draft justification. Also note GPU families are separate quotas (p4d vs p4de).
alex_h: Draft justification I'm planning to send (short):
```
Account: 123456789012
Region: us-west-2
Workload: prod inference + nightly backups
Current problem: nightly snapshot jobs generate 250k IOPS over ~12 min window causing throttling and snapshot failures.
Request: increase gp3 IOPS to 500k, total gp3 provisioned size to +100TiB, snapshots/min limit to 200, volumes per region to 60k. Also request p4d quota to 8 GPUs in us-west-2 for scheduled rollout on 2026-03-20.
Business impact: Blocking production deploy affecting customer latency and capacity.
Mitigations: switching to incremental snapshots, throttled snapshot coordinator, moving archive to S3. Request temporary burst for 30 days while we implement optimizations.
```
sophia: Add expected growth numbers (3 month forecast) and cost owner contact (billing@example.com). Also mention we can accept a temporary limit increase with an audit.
alex_h: ok adding that. Opening case now. Case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home?region=us-west-2#/case?caseId=1234567890
infra-bot: Support case 1234567890 created (priority: urgent). Estimated AWS response 24-48h.
aws-support: Thanks for the case. Please attach: architecture diagram, peak I/O metrics for last 7 days (Grafana screenshots), and whether snapshot traffic can be deferred or moved to S3. Also confirm account owner contact info.
raj_p: I'll attach Grafana panels (volume IOPS, burst credits, snapshot ops) and a list of instances most affected (r6i.large, m6gd.xlarge, gp3-backed volumes).
michael_t: For GPU quota note — specify AZ preference. If p4d isn't available in one AZ we can accept p4de in us-east-1 as a fallback. Also consider requesting spot capacity for non-prod.
alex_h: Also requesting ENI bump: need +2000 ENIs for EKS pod density in us-west-2; autoscaling is failing due to ENI exhaustion. Including that in the case now.
sophia: tagging account manager and asking for expedited review. @aws-support please cc account manager. :pray:
aws-support: Case updated. Provisionally increased gp3 IOPS to 150000 and volumes per region to 60000 for account 123456789012 in us-west-2 for 30 days while snapshot throughput is reviewed. Please upload the requested artifacts to the case to proceed with permanent limits.
alex_h: Great, thanks — we'll monitor tonight's run and upload charts. Leaving case open until snapshots are cleared. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Quota change applied (provisional): gp3 IOPS = 150000, volumes per region = 60000. Next verification sweep in 1h.
